data.heading: Storage Delivered to Your Driveway — Loaded on Your Schedule.
data.body: We place a ground-level unit right where you want it with the Mule Delivery System, then leave you to pack at your own pace. From **$149/mo + $79 delivery**, with $0 due until it arrives.

data.heading: Four sizes, one flat starting price
data.intro: Every unit starts at **$149/mo** and holds ≈ 4,500 lbs per unit. Not sure which fits? Tell us your move and a real local person will size it with you.
data.footnote: **Weight limit:** ≈ 4,500 lbs per unit. **Climate options:** Non-climate (standard) · Insulated · Climate-controlled.

data.heading: Meet the Mule
data.body: Our Mule Delivery System is the difference between a storage box dropped wherever the truck can reach — and one placed exactly where you need it. It's the local edge the national outfits simply don't have.

points.title: Remote-controlled placement
points.body: We guide your unit into tight driveways and alleys by remote — exactly where you want it.

points.title: No driveway or lawn damage
points.body: The Mule sets the box down gently, so your concrete and grass stay just as they were.

points.title: Stays level the whole way
points.body: Your contents ride flat and don't shift in transport — nothing tips, slides, or breaks.

data.heading: One box, plenty of jobs
data.note: **10'×10' doors for Minnesota toys.** Need to store a boat, trailer, or fish house? Ask about units with 10'×10' doors built for Minnesota toys.

data.heading: Real prices. No surprises.
data.body: One clear starting rate, one flat delivery fee, and nothing due until your unit is in your driveway. Keep it as long as you need — it's month-to-month with no penalties for changing your plans.

data.heading: Shipping Containers for Sale
data.body: Buy a wind- and water-tight 20' or 40' container — new one-trip or budget-friendly cargo-worthy used. We publish real starting prices and deliver to your site as soon as next-day.

data.heading: New (one-trip) or used (cargo-worthy)
data.intro: Both are structurally sound and lock securely — the difference is cosmetic wear and price.

cards.title: New — one-trip
cards.body: Manufactured recently and shipped just once, so they look nearly pristine — minimal wear, clean interiors, and a long service life. Ideal when appearance matters or you're planning a build.

cards.title: Used — cargo-worthy
cards.body: Wind- and water-tight with honest cosmetic wear at the best price. Structurally sound and ready for on-site storage or job-site use the day they arrive.

data.heading: Containers for sale
data.intro: Standard, high-cube, double-door, and side-door options in 20' and 40'.

data.heading: Standard vs. high-cube
data.body: Both share the same footprint. The difference is height: standard containers stand 8'6" tall, while high-cube containers add a full foot at 9'6". That extra headroom matters for tall equipment, shelving, and comfortable workshop or office conversions.

cards.title: Tilt-bed delivery
cards.body: We deliver on a tilt-bed truck onto firm, level ground. We'll review your site with you before delivery so it lands exactly where you want it.

cards.title: Clearance you'll need
cards.body: Plan for roughly the container length plus the truck — about 60 feet of straight clearance for a 20', and more for a 40'.

cards.title: Door orientation
cards.body: You choose. Tell us whether you want the doors at the front or rear of the placement and we'll set it down accordingly.

data.heading: Custom modifications
data.body: Doors, windows, vents, electrical, insulation, and full custom builds are available. Tell us your plan and we'll quote the modifications along with the container.

This Privacy Policy explains how AffordABox ("we," "us," or "our") collects, uses, and protects information when you visit our website or request our services.

## Information we collect

When you submit a quote request or contact form, we collect the information you provide — such as your name, phone number, email address, service address or ZIP code, and details about the service you need. We may also automatically collect basic usage data (such as pages visited) through analytics tools.

## How we use your information

- To respond to your quote requests and inquiries.
- To schedule, deliver, and service your rental or purchase.
- To contact you about your order and provide customer support.
- To improve our website and services.

## How we share your information

We do not sell your personal information. We may share information with service providers who help us operate our business (for example, scheduling or communications tools), and where required by law.

## Cookies and analytics

Our website may use cookies and third-party analytics (such as Google Analytics) to understand how visitors use the site. You can control cookies through your browser settings.

frontmatter.blurb: At the heart of our St. Michael yard, this facility pairs drive-up convenience with indoor climate-controlled units for Wright County renters who want quick, local access.

Our Monticello facility on Innsbrook Drive offers drive-up and climate-controlled units just off I-94 — park, load, and go without icy hallways, with oversized doors built for Minnesota boats and campers.

frontmatter.answer: Yes — portable storage, container rentals, and self-storage are all month-to-month with no long-term contracts and no change or cancel fees.
Yes. We publish real starting prices for dumpsters, containers, and portable storage so you can see the price and book in about two minutes — no "call for price" runaround.

entries.title: Do I talk to a real person?

frontmatter.answer: Always. There are no call centers — a real local person answers the phone and usually replies to quote requests within the hour.

entries.title: Do I pay anything up front?

frontmatter.answer: No — $0 is due until your dumpster, container, or storage unit is delivered.
As soon as next-day across our service area, with same-day often available near our St. Michael yard.

We serve Minnesota only — primarily St. Michael and Wright County, Sherburne County, and the northwest Twin Cities metro through Hennepin and Anoka counties, including Monticello, Elk River, Buffalo, Anoka, Rogers, Albertville, and Otsego.
Access hours are posted at each facility; office hours are Mon–Fri 8AM–5PM CT. Contact us for current gate-access details.

entries.title: Do you have units for boats or campers?

frontmatter.answer: Yes — we offer oversized units with 10' doors for boats, campers, trailers, and other large vehicles.

entries.title: Can I reserve a unit online?

frontmatter.answer: Yes — reserve online with no credit card required to hold your unit, and ask about online-only rate discounts. If a size shows as unavailable, leave your info and we'll call the moment one opens.

entries.title: What's the difference between drive-up and climate-controlled?

frontmatter.answer: Drive-up units let you pull right up and load without hallways — ideal in Minnesota winters. Climate-controlled units hold a steadier temperature for sensitive items like electronics, documents, and furniture.
We have two Minnesota facilities: Monticello (10111 Innsbrook Drive) and St. Michael (at our 43rd St NE yard). Both offer drive-up and climate-controlled units.

entries.title: Is AffordABox the same as PODS?

frontmatter.answer: No. AffordABox is a locally owned Minnesota company and is not associated with PODS. PODS is a registered trademark of The Procter & Gamble Company.

entries.title: Can I store a boat, trailer, or fish house?

frontmatter.answer: Ask about units with 10'×10' doors built for Minnesota toys like boats, trailers, and fish houses.

entries.title: How long can I keep the unit?

frontmatter.answer: As long as you like — it's month-to-month with no long-term contract and no change or cancellation fees.

entries.title: What size unit do I need?

frontmatter.answer: An 8×8 holds a studio, 8×12 fits 1–2 bedrooms, 8×16 (our most popular) suits 2–3 bedrooms, and 8×20 handles a full 3–4 bedroom home. Each unit holds about 4,500 lbs.

entries.title: What is the Mule Delivery System?

frontmatter.answer: The Mule is a remote-controlled system that places your unit precisely into tight driveways and alleys without damaging your driveway or yard, and it keeps the unit level so your contents don't shift during transport.

entries.title: How much does portable storage cost?

frontmatter.answer: Portable storage starts at $149/mo plus a $79 delivery fee, with $0 due until your unit is delivered. It's month-to-month with no change or cancel fees.
Rent if it's for a defined project or short-to-medium term; buy if you'll need on-site storage indefinitely. We're happy to talk through the math for your situation.

entries.title: What can I use a rented container for?

frontmatter.answer: On-site project storage, a workshop, a portable office, overflow inventory, or seasonal and event storage — they're wind- and water-tight and lock securely.

entries.title: Do you deliver and pick up the rental?

frontmatter.answer: We deliver it to your site and pick it up when you're done. Delivery is available as soon as next-day across our service area.

entries.title: Can I rent a container month-to-month?

frontmatter.answer: Yes. Container rentals are month-to-month with no long-term contract — keep it for a single project or as long as you need.
Yes — doors, windows, vents, electrical, and custom builds are available. Tell us your plan and we'll quote the modifications.

entries.title: Which way do the doors face when delivered?

frontmatter.answer: You choose. Tell us whether you want the doors at the front or rear of the placement and we'll set it down accordingly.

entries.title: How is the container delivered and how much clearance do I need?

frontmatter.answer: We deliver on a tilt-bed truck. Plan for roughly the container length plus the truck — about 60 feet of straight clearance for a 20' and more for a 40' — on firm, level ground. We'll review your site with you before delivery.

entries.title: What's the difference between standard and high-cube?

frontmatter.answer: High-cube containers are a foot taller (9'6" vs 8'6"), giving you extra headroom for tall equipment, shelving, or comfortable workshop and office conversions.

entries.title: How much does a shipping container cost?

frontmatter.answer: Used 20' containers start around $1,800 and new one-trip 20' containers start around $3,500, with 40' and high-cube options priced higher. We show real starting prices — never "call for price."

entries.title: What's the difference between new and used containers?

frontmatter.answer: New (one-trip) containers have made a single cargo voyage and look nearly pristine. Used (cargo-worthy) containers are wind- and water-tight with honest cosmetic wear at a lower price. Both are structurally sound for storage.

entries.title: What size dumpster do I need?

frontmatter.answer: A 10-yard suits small cleanouts, 15-yard fits a room remodel, 20-yard handles larger renovations, and 25-yard is for big demo or estate jobs. Not sure? A real local person will size it with you in about two minutes.

entries.title: Will the dumpster damage my driveway?

frontmatter.answer: We take care with placement and can use boards to protect your surface. Let us know about tight or delicate driveways when you book.

entries.title: Do I have to pay up front?

frontmatter.answer: No. $0 is due until your dumpster is delivered, so you only pay once it's in your driveway.

entries.title: What can I put in the dumpster?

frontmatter.answer: Most household junk, renovation debris, furniture, roofing, and yard waste are fine. Hazardous materials, tires, batteries, paint, and appliances with refrigerant need special handling — just ask and we'll point you the right way.

entries.title: How fast can you deliver a dumpster?

frontmatter.answer: We deliver as soon as next-day across our service area, and same-day is often available near our St. Michael yard. Tell us your ZIP and we'll confirm the soonest window.

entries.title: What's included in the dumpster rental price?

frontmatter.answer: Every dumpster is a flat rate that includes delivery, a 7-day rental period, pickup, and disposal of up to 5,000 lbs. There are no surprise fees — anything over the included tonnage is billed at a simple $0.10 per pound.

frontmatter.blurb: Small-town Loretto and the surrounding Medina countryside are well within our quick-delivery range for dumpsters, containers and portable storage.
The Hamel and Medina area gets the same tight-driveway Mule delivery and transparent pricing, an easy run down Highway 55 from our Wright County base.
A busy metro-edge suburb, Maple Grove relies on us for renovation roll-offs and driveway storage with the kind of personal scheduling the national chains can't match.
Up the Highway 10 corridor in Sherburne County, Big Lake homeowners use us for lake-property cleanouts, off-season toy storage and renovation dumpsters.
At the meeting point of Hennepin, Anoka and Wright counties, Dayton's fast-growing developments are an easy delivery for dumpsters, containers and portable storage.
Bordering both St. Michael and Elk River, Otsego is one of our most-served towns — the Mule places units cleanly in newer subdivisions without touching the lawn or driveway.
Practically next door to our St. Michael yard, Albertville and the outlet-mall area see near-instant delivery on everything from 10-yard dumpsters to 8×20 portable units.
Sitting right on the I-94 corridor between our yard and the metro, Rogers gets some of our quickest delivery windows for containers and dumpsters alike.
Growing Andover neighborhoods lean on us for remodel dumpsters and on-site storage, an easy run up from the metro edge through Anoka County.
We bring the same local, no-call-center service into the city — the Mule shines in tight Minneapolis driveways and alleys where the big national outfits won't go.
One of our strongest converting markets, Anoka gets fast roll-off and container delivery where the Rum meets the Mississippi, serving renovation and cleanout projects across Anoka County.
The Wright County seat is core territory for us — homeowners around Buffalo Lake and contractors downtown count on next-day dumpsters and driveway-friendly portable storage.
Just across the Mississippi from our Otsego neighbors, Elk River sits a short hop up Highway 101 from our St. Michael yard for quick dumpster drops and Mule-delivered storage in Sherburne County.
Portable storage, roll-off dumpsters and containers reach Monticello in a day, and our drive-up self-storage facility on Innsbrook Drive serves the Lake Maria and I-94 corridor year-round.
Home of our yard at 12231 43rd St NE — we offer same-day and next-day delivery across St. Michael and all of Wright County, the fastest turnaround anywhere in our footprint.
